located_point.method: Site index point retained (Wikidata 'Rojdi', a settlement). The composite shows irrigated fields with a broad bright area of bare ground about 600 m across east of the point; without a plan it cannot be identified with the mound or its walls, so the mound was not located independently.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: no plan or published description was available to tie any straight feature to Harappan architecture
sources.rights_notice: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026

notes: The plan library holds no Rojdi plan, and the held Indian Archaeology volumes (1963-64, 1983-84, 1990-91, 1991-92) mention Rojdi only in passing or as a comparison for other sites; none carries a Rojdi plan. A repeat needs the Rojdi excavation report (Possehl and Raval 1989) and its site plan.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan found, and without one no imagery feature can be identified as Harappan architecture.
